definition: Karen Livescu is an American computer scientist specializing in speech processing and natural language processing, and applications of deep learning to these topics.
details: She is a professor in the Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago and a part-time associate professor of computer science at the University of Chicago.

explainer.lead: Karen Livescu is an American computer scientist.

timeline.what: Livescu majored in physics at Princeton University, graduating in 1996 with an honors thesis on signal processing in speech supervised by computer scientist Kenneth Steiglitz.

She became a Clare Boothe Luce Postdoctoral Lecturer at MIT, and then a research assistant professor at the Toyota Technological Institute, before becoming a regular-rank assistant professor at the Toyota Technological Institute in 2008.
She was promoted to associate professor at both the Toyota Technological Institute and the University of Chicago in 2017, and to full professor at the Toyota Technological Institute in 2021.
